cat > /tmp/ab_gemini.py <<'PY'
import sys,json,time,urllib.request,urllib.error,os,re
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/weather-pipeline/repo/scripts')
os.chdir('/opt/weather-pipeline/repo')
key=[l.split('=',1)[1].strip().strip('"\'') for l in open('/opt/weather-pipeline/repo/.env') if l.startswith('GEMINI_API_KEY=')][0]
import generate_ai_analysis as g
c=json.load(open('/tmp/gemini_retry_prompt_cache.json'))
prompt=c['prompt'] if 'prompt' in c else [v for v in c.values() if isinstance(v,str) and len(v)>500][0]
print('prompt chars',len(prompt),'cache keys',list(c.keys()))
def call(model,think=None):
    gc={}
    if think: gc['thinkingConfig']=think
    body={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text":prompt}]}],"systemInstruction":{"parts":[{"text":g.GEMINI_STYLE_INSTRUCTION}]}}
    if gc: body['generationConfig']=gc
    req=urllib.request.Request(f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent?key={key}",data=json.dumps(body).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},method="POST")
    t=time.time()
    try:
        r=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=150).read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return {'err':f"{e.code} {e.read().decode()[:300]}",'sec':round(time.time()-t,1)}
    parts=r['candidates'][0]['content']['parts']
    txt="".join(p.get('text','') for p in parts if not p.get('thought'))
    return {'sec':round(time.time()-t,1),'chars':len(txt),'nparts':len(parts),'usage':r.get('usageMetadata'),'finish':r['candidates'][0].get('finishReason'),'text':txt}
runs=[("gemini-2.5-flash",None),("gemini-3.8-flash",{"thinkingLevel":"low"}),("gemini-3.8-flash",{"thinkingLevel":"minimal"}),("gemini-3.7-flash",{"thinkingLevel":"low"})]
out={}
for m,t in runs:
    k=m+("|"+t["thinkingLevel"] if t else "")
    out[k]=call(m,t); o=out[k]
    print(k,{x:o.get(x) for x in ('sec','chars','nparts','finish','err')},o.get('usage'),flush=True)
json.dump(out,open('/tmp/ab_out.json','w'),ensure_ascii=False)
PY
nohup python3 /tmp/ab_gemini.py > /tmp/ab.log 2>&1 &
sleep 40; cat /tmp/ab.log | cut -c1-400
